extracted.intended_audience: people attempting to create or find a Wikipedia article (new or existing Wikipedia editors/contributors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating or locating a Wikipedia article (how to handle a missing-title notice, account requirements, searching for alternatives, and follow-up actions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed status required to create new articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or autoconfirmed you cannot create the page; consider creating an account and meeting autoconfirmed requirements before attempting to create the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft for review
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot directly create an article (e.g., due to account status or notability concerns), follow the article wizard process or submit a draft so experienced editors can help or review the submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Damon Wayans SNL' in existing articles. Check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify that the topic isn't already covered under a different title or spelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the desired title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate backlinks to discover existing coverage or appropriate target pages for redirects or merges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider adding a redirect to the correct title
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the desired title is a variant or misspelling of an existing article, create a redirect rather than a new page to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for case sensitivity and capitalization rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure correct capitalization when searching or creating titles; minor capitalization differences can yield different pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow for database update delay for recently created pages
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a newly created page but can't see it, either wait a short time for propagation or use the purge function to refresh.

rubrics_metrics.name: If page was deleted, consult the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion history and rationale before attempting to recreate content; address issues cited in deletion (e.g., notability, sourcing) when resubmitting.
